entities.name: Full Configuration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE releases/clears most current dedicated radio configurations and applies default configurations, except for certain preserved elements like MCG C-RNTI and security configurations.

entities.name: MCG C-RNTI
entities.description: Cell Radio Network Temporary Identifier for the Master Cell Group, preserved during full configuration.

entities.name: AS Security Configurations
entities.description: Access Stratum security configurations associated with the master key, preserved during full configuration.

entities.name: SRB1/SRB2 Configurations
entities.description: Signaling Radio Bearer configurations for SRB1 and SRB2, preserved during full configuration.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with Sync
entities.description: Condition where spCellConfig in masterCellGroup includes reconfigurationWithSync, triggering release of common radio configurations and use of default timer values.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer used in radio link failure procedures, set to default value during full configuration if reconfiguration with sync is included.

entities.name: Timer T311
entities.description: Timer used in connection re-establishment procedures, set to default value during full configuration if reconfiguration with sync is included.

entities.name: srb-ToAddModList
entities.description: List of SRB identities to add or modify, used to establish RLC entities and apply default SRB configurations during full configuration.

entities.name: PDU Session
entities.description: Protocol Data Unit session, part of current UE configuration; SDAP entity and associated DRBs are released during full configuration.

entities.name: TMGI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Group Identity, part of current UE configuration; SDAP entity and associated multicast MRBs are released during full configuration.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE
entities.description: Condition where UE is connected with a L2 U2N Relay UE via PC5-RRC connection, affecting timer values used during full configuration.

relations.description: Full configuration procedure preserves MCG C-RNTI.
Full configuration procedure preserves AS security configurations.
Full configuration procedure preserves SRB1/SRB2 configurations.
If reconfiguration with sync is included, timer T310 is set to default value.
If reconfiguration with sync is included, timer T311 is set to default value.
srb-ToAddModList guides establishment of RLC entities and application of default SRB configurations during full configuration.
Full configuration procedure releases SDAP entity and associated DRBs for each PDU session.
Full configuration procedure releases SDAP entity and associated multicast MRBs for each TMGI.
If UE is L2 U2N Remote UE, specific timer values from SIB1 are used during full configuration.
